back_translation: We bring you 'the lost one'… literally. (The Egyptian idiom 'he brings the lost one' means someone resourceful who can track down anything.)
notes: The English pun on 'deliver the goods' doesn't work in Arabic, so I swapped it for the Egyptian colloquial idiom 'يجيب التايهة', which keeps the figurative-vs-literal joke about getting any item to you, and I used colloquial 'حرفيًا', which is popular with young urban Egyptians, instead of a stiff Modern Standard Arabic phrasing.
